title: Hexus Salts Blueberry Cherry Cranberry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Blueberry Cherry Cranberry by Hexus is a bold triple-berry blend that balances juicy sweetness with subtle tang and richness. Blueberry brings a soft, mellow base, while Cherry adds depth and a hint of tartness. Cranberry lifts the mix with a sharp edge that keeps the flavour crisp and moreish. Together, these three flavours deliver a smooth and punchy vape with a satisfying fruity profile. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid offers a smooth, comfortable throat hit and fast-absorbing nicotine. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with refillable pod kits , starter devices and low-powered vape pens . Hexus Nic Salts are available in 10mg and 20mg strengths and come in a wide range of flavours that combine sweet, fruity, icy and classic profiles with smooth nic salt satisfaction.
